examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A finished response in Markdown: a heading, bold and inline code, a numbered list, a table and a fenced code block rendered as a copyable CodeBlock.

examples.name: Streaming
examples.summary: Tokens arriving: the text grows every few milliseconds with a blinking caret at the end, the region is busy, and the code fence stays plain until it closes. Replay restarts it.

examples.name: WithCitations
examples.summary: Numbered citations in the text resolve against the sources: each `[n]` shows the source title in a tooltip and links to item n of the Sources list under the response.

examples.name: UnsafeInput
examples.summary: Model output carrying a script tag, an inline event handler and a javascript: link renders as plain text with the unsafe link dropped; nothing is injected as HTML.
